android.desc:
aText-TV brings teletext pages from Europe's public and commercial broadcasters
to your pocket – the app has been serving its users for 16 years. It fetches
pages directly from the broadcasters' own servers and displays them in the
traditional, fast-to-browse teletext view, where links can be tapped straight
from the page image.

FEATURES

• News, live sports results and TV listings in a few seconds
• 80+ channels from 18 countries – public and commercial broadcasters gathered
  into one app
• Fast page and subpage browsing by swiping
• Tappable links directly on the teletext page image
• Bookmarks for your favorite pages, with quick access back to them
• Page Watch – get notified when a page you're watching updates
• Optional automatic page refresh
• Zoom and content stretch for different screen sizes and orientations
• User interface in 19 languages
• Offline reading support for previously loaded pages
• Startup channel/page setting and active-channel management

SUPPORTED CHANNELS BY COUNTRY (official channel names)

Austria: Kabel Eins, Kabel Eins Doku, ORF 1, ORF 2, ORF III, ORF Sport +,
ProSieben, ProSieben MAXX, SAT.1, SAT.1 Gold, sixx

Bosnia and Herzegovina: BHT 1, FTV

Croatia: HRT 1

Czech Republic: ČT1

Denmark: DR1, DR2

Finland: YLE Teksti-TV

Germany: 3sat, ARD Text, hr-text, Kabel Eins, Kabel Eins Doku, KiKA-TEXT,
NDR Text, ProSieben, ProSieben MAXX, Saartext, SAT.1, SAT.1 Gold, sixx, SWR,
WDR Text, ZDF, ZDFinfo, ZDFneo

Hungary: M1 (MTV1)

Iceland: RÚV

Italy (Televideo RAI): Nazionale, Abruzzo, Alto Adige, Basilicata, Calabria,
Campania, Emilia-Romagna, Friuli Venezia Giulia, Lazio, Liguria, Lombardia,
Marche, Molise, Piemonte, Puglia, Sardegna, Sicilia, Toscana, Trentino

Netherlands: NOS Teletekst, Omroep Zeeland

Poland: Polsat, TVP1, TVP2, TVP3, TVP Historia, TVP Kultura, TVP Polonia,
TVP Sport

Portugal: RTP

Slovenia: RTV SLO

Spain: Antena 3, La 1 (TVE), laSexta

Sweden: SVT Text

Switzerland: Kabel Eins, ProSieben, ProSieben MAXX, Puls 8, RSI La 1, RSI La 2,
RTS Deux, RTS Un, SAT.1, SAT.1 Gold, sixx, SRF 1, SRF Info, SRF zwei

Ukraine: InterTEXT

Channels may stop working because of changes made by the broadcasters. If that
happens, contact the developer with a description of the problem, the channel,
the device name and the operating system version.

This application is not an official app of any broadcaster and is not affiliated
with them.

THIS APPLICATION

quotes.text:
Still active in Finland as well:

YLE: https://yle.fi/aihe/tekstitv

MTV (not the American one): https://www.mtvtekstikanava.fi/

Some people use them via phone apps as they tend to be faster and cleaner than webpages to check e.g. sports results. E.g. aText-TV (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.harjuconsulting.texttv) has many channels from a dozen countries.
